item.title: INTERNAL DECAY Announce New EP “Fires Of The Forgotten”, Title Track Out Now
item.description: The fire within Swedish cult death metal band Internal Decay burns again. item.title: THE INTEMPERATE SONS Release Cover of Julien-K’s ‘Photo Voltaire’
item.description: The Intemperate Sons open 2026 with a powerful cross-genre collaboration, releasing their cover of Julien-K’s “Photo Voltaire”. The track mixes the band’s signature alternative hard-rock foundation with the dark, synth-driven atmosphere of the original, creating a fresh reinterpretation that highlights the strengths of both groups.
